headline: No Dogs in Space is a music history podcast for true obsessives
summary: The music history podcast 'No Dogs in Space' hasn't released new episodes since July 2024. Its abbreviated third season focused on experimental rock. Fans eagerly await new content despite enjoying past seasons.

headline: Zuckerberg's yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
summary: A small skiff was rescued near Alaska by the cruise ship Wilderness Legacy. Tracking data shows Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad, was actually closer to the stranded boat. The incident highlights a missed opportunity for the billionaire's vessel.

headline: 49ers coach says his Tesla was on Autopilot when he crashed
summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was involved in an accident four weeks ago near Palo Alto. He initially claimed the accident was his fault. Shanahan recently revealed his Tesla's Autopilot was engaged during the crash.

headline: Dropbox is a PC builder's best friend
summary: The author relied on Dropbox to safeguard a large crowdfunded game design project. A major concern was losing all work stored locally on a home-built PC. Dropbox provided crucial backup, preventing potential project failure.

headline: Warner Bros. Stirs Controversy After Posting 'Embarrassing' AI Dog Podcast for The End of Oak Street
summary: Warner Bros. is under fire for promoting 'The End of Oak Street' with an AI dog podcast. The collaboration featuring Ewan McGregor and Anne Hathaway's film sparked controversy. Many viewers found the AI-generated content 'embarrassing'.

headline: Marvel Tokon PC Launch Is So Bad That Famed FGC Content Creator Maximilian Dood Uninstalled the Game on Stream
summary: 'Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' PC launch weekend is plagued with severe issues. FGC content creator Maximilian Dood publicly uninstalled the game on stream. The game's troubled performance has deeply disappointed players.

headline: Blizzard Reportedly Leads Xbox as 'Top-Performing' Studio Thanks to Overwatch and Diablo
summary: Blizzard Entertainment is reportedly Xbox's 'top-performing' studio under Microsoft. Its success is driven by popular titles like Overwatch and Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred. This reinforces Blizzard's key role within the Xbox gaming ecosystem.

summary: Discover the best deals available today on popular gaming and tech items. Featured offers include the highly anticipated Civilization VII. Grab discounts on AirPods Pro 3, Spider-Man: Brand New Day Steelbook, and other exciting products.

headline: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appears in court after extradition
summary: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appeared in court in Dublin after extradition from Dubai. The Irish Prison Service used a specially equipped bulletproof and bombproof van for his transport. He faces charges related to directing a criminal organization.

headline: How Kinahan's hearing unfolded inside the courtroom in Dublin
summary: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan faced charges in a Dublin courtroom. He was accused of directing the activities of a criminal organization. His appearance followed his recent extradition from Dubai.

headline: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living
summary: Prime Minister Burnham is accelerating a ban on misleading 'subscription traps'. This measure aims to ease cost-of-living burdens for consumers. The announcement is part of a series made during a UK tour.

headline: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
summary: Evidence alleging South African special forces murdered a top detective has been given to the BBC. Detective Frans Mathipa was shot while driving. The BBC gained access to the prosecution's case against eight accused men.
